title: Privacy Stack 1/4 - local discovery
description: Audit local Python/runtime, existing 3EN Security Monitor candidates and router/Pi-hole integration state before GUI deployment. Require an automatically verified Pi-hole SSH management path because write operations must never fall back to manual user transport.
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$s=Get-Content 'C:/3EN-Agent/security-privacy-stack/deploy-state.json' -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if(-not $s.python){throw 'python missing'};if(-not(Test-Path $s.routerPiState)){throw 'router-pihole state missing'};$rp=Get-Content $s.routerPiState -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if(-not $rp.piholeDns){throw 'pihole DNS not healthy'};if(-not $rp.piSsh){throw 'BLOCKED: Pi-hole SSH key management path was not auto-discovered'};if(-not $rp.piKey -or -not(Test-Path $rp.piKey)){throw 'BLOCKED: discovered Pi-hole SSH key is unavailable'};Write-Host ('PRIVACY_DISCOVERY_TEST=PASS;PI_SSH=TRUE;MONITOR_CANDIDATES='+@($s.monitorCandidates).Count)
